prompt:
Scene:
Same square frame and canyon. Clear night with a full moon high in the sky on the right. Cool silver-blue ambient, sharp moon-cast shadows, zero artificial light pollution, mild starfield visible between clouds.

Subject:
The identical rising water column from the reference, same base and height, now reading as a pale silver ribbon under moonlight. A very faint moonbow (lunar rainbow) arcs through the rising mist at mid-height, almost invisible but clearly present to the trained eye. The helicopter's position is preserved and its navigation strobes are visible as small red and green pinpoints.

Important details:
Preserve column geometry and helicopter position. Moonlight palette: silver, cobalt, charcoal. Stars readable where the sky is clear. Canyon walls lose color and become tonal forms. The column itself should feel nearly translucent against the sky, with droplets catching moonlight as pale sparkles. A long moon-cast shadow of the column stretches across the canyon floor toward the left.

Use case:
Fourth and final image in the cycle. Closes the series with a silent, near-monochrome night atmosphere while preserving every structural element.

Constraints:
PRESERVE the reference image canyon, column base, rise height, and helicopter position. No readable text, no watermark, no logos, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, no artificial city light, no sci-fi beams, no stylized illustration.
